responsibility: This scheduling description provides DFA pipeline models for LEON-family single-issue processors covered by the cpu values leon, leon3, and leon3v7, including the associated Gaisler Research FPU. Besides normal load/store and floating-point latencies, it also models the UT699 load hazard workaround through a distinct reservation keyed by the fix_ut699 attribute, so the scheduler can honor LEON-specific errata-sensitive timing.
